title: Real-World Model A v2 Pre-registration

V4.name: V3_Pairwise_Ranking
V4.model: Linear MarginRanking / BPR trained on train_pairs_v2
V4.loss: max(0, 1 - (w^T x_vuln - w^T x_safe)) + L2 regularization

VM.name: Mixed_Real_Juliet
VM.model: Best of V3/V4 retrained on train_v2 (weight 0.70) + Juliet S-rand train split (weight 0.30)
VM.target: Cross-domain generalization and synthetic CWE grounding

Baselines.static_only: Logistic regression on 104 static analysis features

metrics: precision, lift, and recall at top 10% operating point for CWE-476, 400, 416, 787, 119
dev_evaluation.paired_tests: Paired bootstrap difference (2000 resamples, grouped by commit_id) vs L1 and champion with Holm adjustment

selection_rule.gate: Must beat L1 on dev length-matched AUROC with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
selection_rule.ranking: Highest mean of (dev length-matched AUROC, dev pair_correct)
selection_rule.tie_breaker: Simpler model on 95% bootstrap CI overlap
selection_rule.fallback: If none beats L1 on length-matched AUROC, fallback to V3 and explicitly document failure to decouple length
selection_rule.stacker_V6: Fit triage stacker V6: LogisticRegression(selected_model_logit, log(n_tokens))

decision_rule_and_thresholds.binary_threshold: t_bin chosen to maximize balanced accuracy on dev

three_way_thresholds.t_high: Threshold achieving precision >= 0.80 on dev (or top 5% by score if unreachable)
three_way_thresholds.t_low: Threshold achieving SAFE NPV >= 0.90 on dev (or bottom 20% by score if unreachable)

freeze_protocol: Write SHA-256 of all model artifacts, scalers, and thresholds to results/p10/freeze_a.json BEFORE touching test sets.

final_evaluation.secondary: Single call to load_locked_test(reason='P10 secondary, viewed in P6')
